headline: Bose launches new wired earbuds with noise cancellation
summary: Bose launched new wired, USB-C earbuds with active noise cancellation, its first wired model in about a decade after discontinuing the category in 2015. The earbuds need no charging since they draw power through the wire.

claims.statement: Bose launched new wired earbuds with active noise cancellation, its first wired model in about a decade.

sources.quote: Bose Launches New Wired Earbuds After More Than a Decade

claims.statement: The earbuds use USB-C and need no charging since they draw power through the wire.

sources.quote: The new wired USB-C earbuds mix old-school elements with modern audio features.
do away with battery anxiety and the need to remember to charge them every few days.

claims.statement: Bose discontinued its wired earbuds line in 2015 before this relaunch.

sources.quote: The Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds are the first new wired headphones from the brand since 2015, inspired directly by teen preferences.
